package domain

import (
	"strings"

	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

type PlanningSource string

const (
	PlanningSourceStudent PlanningSource = "STUDENT"
	PlanningSourceTeacher PlanningSource = "TEACHER"
	PlanningSourceSystem  PlanningSource = "SYSTEM"
)

type PlanningReason string

const (
	PlanningReasonInitial PlanningReason = "INITIAL"
	PlanningReasonReplan  PlanningReason = "REPLAN"
)

// PlanningConstraints contains explicit preferences for this plan. Objective
// learner state is deliberately absent: Planner always reads it from Student.
type PlanningConstraints struct {
	Language       string `json:"language,omitempty"`
	WeeklyMinutes  int    `json:"weekly_minutes,omitempty"`
	PreferredPace  string `json:"preferred_pace,omitempty"`
	Deadline       string `json:"deadline,omitempty"`
	ProjectContext string `json:"project_context,omitempty"`
}

// PlanningAuditRefs links a request back to the teaching interaction that
// initiated it without copying dialog text into Planner.
type PlanningAuditRefs struct {
	DialogID          string `json:"dialog_id,omitempty"`
	SourceMessageID   string `json:"source_message_id,omitempty"`
	TeacherDecisionID string `json:"teacher_decision_id,omitempty"`
}

type PlanningIntent struct {
	Source           PlanningSource      `json:"source"`
	Reason           PlanningReason      `json:"reason"`
	DesiredOutcome   string              `json:"desired_outcome"`
	RequestedTargets []TargetRef         `json:"requested_targets,omitempty"`
	Constraints      PlanningConstraints `json:"constraints"`
	AuditRefs        PlanningAuditRefs   `json:"audit_refs"`
}

func NormalizePlanningIntent(input PlanningIntent) (PlanningIntent, error) {
	input.DesiredOutcome = strings.TrimSpace(input.DesiredOutcome)
	input.Constraints.Language = normalizeCode(input.Constraints.Language)
	input.Constraints.PreferredPace = normalizeCode(input.Constraints.PreferredPace)
	input.Constraints.Deadline = strings.TrimSpace(input.Constraints.Deadline)
	input.Constraints.ProjectContext = strings.TrimSpace(input.Constraints.ProjectContext)
	input.AuditRefs.DialogID = strings.TrimSpace(input.AuditRefs.DialogID)
	input.AuditRefs.SourceMessageID = strings.TrimSpace(input.AuditRefs.SourceMessageID)
	input.AuditRefs.TeacherDecisionID = strings.TrimSpace(input.AuditRefs.TeacherDecisionID)

	if !validPlanningSource(input.Source) || !validPlanningReason(input.Reason) ||
		input.DesiredOutcome == "" || len(input.DesiredOutcome) > 4000 ||
		len(input.Constraints.ProjectContext) > 8000 || len(input.Constraints.Deadline) > 64 ||
		(input.Constraints.WeeklyMinutes != 0 &&
			(input.Constraints.WeeklyMinutes < 15 || input.Constraints.WeeklyMinutes > 10080)) ||
		len(input.RequestedTargets) > 100 {
		return PlanningIntent{}, ErrValidation
	}
	for _, value := range []string{
		input.AuditRefs.DialogID, input.AuditRefs.SourceMessageID, input.AuditRefs.TeacherDecisionID,
	} {
		if value != "" {
			if _, err := uuid.Parse(value); err != nil {
				return PlanningIntent{}, ErrValidation
			}
		}
	}
	if input.AuditRefs.SourceMessageID != "" && input.AuditRefs.DialogID == "" {
		return PlanningIntent{}, ErrValidation
	}
	targets, err := NormalizeTargetRefs(input.RequestedTargets)
	if err != nil {
		return PlanningIntent{}, err
	}
	input.RequestedTargets = SortTargetRefs(targets)
	return input, nil
}

func validPlanningSource(input PlanningSource) bool {
	return input == PlanningSourceStudent || input == PlanningSourceTeacher || input == PlanningSourceSystem
}

func validPlanningReason(input PlanningReason) bool {
	return input == PlanningReasonInitial || input == PlanningReasonReplan
}
